name: Warren Lyle
life: Warren took an office job after hot linen burned his forearm. He is still quickest to spot a bad laundry claim by looking at the worker's hands. A neat report with no trace of the people who did the work makes him uneasy. People around the crossing outside Verve Nail Studio know Warren by a small Monday habit. Warren notices whose chair is empty and who has stayed talking after an appointment.
voice: I used to work on a hotel laundry line. I found three identical claims under three different machine numbers. I want the service company to come and point to each machine in person.
appearance: Warren has two dimples that appear only with a full smile. Look for short sandy hair and a marked widow's peak. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a charcoal zip cardigan with a pen clipped inside the neckline. In conversation Warren gives a little nod before asking a hard question.
personality: Is a careful borrower and a reckless lender. Things leave this person's house with elaborate instructions and very little expectation of ever coming back.
agenda: To settle the failed-valve claim before the Wash House loses its hotel work.
family: Nadia Holland is Warren’s younger cousin. Warren remembers the birthdays. Nadia asks what the birthday guest would like this year. A present that was perfect at sixteen may be completely wrong at forty. They take the trouble of finding out. Asked about *The broken till*, Nadia says, “I wrote everyone's sandwiches in pictures. The cook hung the sheet beside the menu.”
connections: Dee Varma. Their next conversation will decide what evidence the hotel needs before sending its linen here.
